svg.title: One task, three actors: the agent proposes and works, LEVI checks and records, the person holds every gate
svg.desc: A swim-lane workflow in nine steps: plan, check, approve, pilot, accept, remaining episodes, review, commit, record. Only the person approves, accepts and commits; the harness records cost and verified facts around the task.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Agent work is cheap to start and cheap to undo, because only a person can approve, accept and commit.

svg.text: Uncertainty is a valid answer. Each suggestion cites the frames it was read from, and a commit can be undone through the same review.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Around every task the harness records cost per agent and per dataset and keeps what a person verified for the next task.
